description: Uploads changed modules in one atomic batch (tgcloud push). Without files, mirrors the whole local module set (deletions included) and, when tgcloud.jsonc names static.source, uploads that build folder exactly as it is on disk. push never runs the bundler — after front-end edits call deploy, or the previous build goes live. A targeted push never deletes other modules and leaves static files untouched unless the target is the build folder. push does not migrate the database; it only prints pending schema changes. Adding or removing a handler can leave the webhook out of sync — follow with webhook_sync. force=true skips the revision check and requires confirm: true.

confirm.description: Required confirm: true for destructive operations (the --force flag, reset, and similar)

files.description: Specific files or directories to deploy; omit to deploy every change

project_dir.description: Absolute path to a tgcloud project directory (contains .tgcloud/)

name: push
title: Deploy to the cloud
